defmodule AuthGateway.PermissionEngine do
  @moduledoc """
  Enumeration-based permission engine for microservice authorization.
  Permissions are encoded as a list of permission atoms in JWT claims.
  """

  @valid_permissions MapSet.new([
    :read, :write, :delete, :admin, :audit,
    :deploy, :config, :billing, :superuser, :root
  ])

  @doc "Check if user has all required permissions"
  def has_permission?(user_permissions, required_permissions) when is_list(user_permissions) and is_list(required_permissions) do
    user_set = MapSet.new(user_permissions)
    required_set = MapSet.new(required_permissions)
    MapSet.subset?(required_set, user_set)
  end
  def has_permission?(_, _), do: false

  @doc "Validate that all permissions are recognized"
  def valid_permission_set?(perms) when is_list(perms) do
    perm_set = MapSet.new(perms)
    MapSet.subset?(perm_set, @valid_permissions) and
      MapSet.size(perm_set) == length(perms)  # no duplicates
  end
  def valid_permission_set?(_), do: false

  @doc "Get permission level description"
  def permission_level(perms) when is_list(perms) do
    cond do
      :root in perms -> :root
      :superuser in perms -> :superuser
      :admin in perms -> :admin
      true -> :user
    end
  end
  def permission_level(_), do: :user
end

defmodule AuthGateway.TokenValidator do
  @moduledoc """
  Validates and decodes authorization tokens.
  Token format: base64(JSON{sub, iat, exp, perms, sig})
  """

  @token_secret System.get_env("TOKEN_SECRET") || raise "TOKEN_SECRET not set"
  @token_max_age 3600
  @max_permissions_count 10

  @valid_permission_strings MapSet.new([
    "read", "write", "delete", "admin", "audit",
    "deploy", "config", "billing", "superuser", "root"
  ])

  def validate_token(token_string) when is_binary(token_string) do
    with {:ok, decoded} <- decode_token(token_string),
         {:ok, claims} <- parse_claims(decoded),
         :ok <- verify_signature(claims, decoded),
         :ok <- verify_expiration(claims),
         :ok <- verify_permissions(claims) do
      {:ok, claims}
    end
  end
  def validate_token(_), do: {:error, :invalid_token_format}

  defp decode_token(token_string) do
    case Base.url_decode64(token_string, padding: false) do
      {:ok, decoded} when byte_size(decoded) <= 4096 -> {:ok, decoded}
      {:ok, _} -> {:error, :token_too_large}
      :error -> {:error, :invalid_encoding}
    end
  end

  defp parse_claims(decoded) do
    case Jason.decode(decoded) do
      {:ok, %{"sub" => sub, "iat" => iat, "exp" => exp, "perms" => perms, "sig" => sig}}
        when is_binary(sub) and is_integer(iat) and is_integer(exp) and is_list(perms) and is_binary(sig) ->
        # Convert string permissions to atoms safely using a whitelist
        case convert_permissions(perms) do
          {:ok, perm_atoms} ->
            {:ok, %{sub: sub, iat: iat, exp: exp, perms: perm_atoms, sig: sig}}
          {:error, _} = err -> err
        end
      {:ok, _} -> {:error, :missing_claims}
      {:error, _} -> {:error, :invalid_json}
    end
  end

  defp convert_permissions(perms) when length(perms) > @max_permissions_count do
    {:error, :too_many_permissions}
  end
  defp convert_permissions(perms) do
    Enum.reduce_while(perms, {:ok, []}, fn perm, {:ok, acc} ->
      if is_binary(perm) and MapSet.member?(@valid_permission_strings, perm) do
        {:cont, {:ok, [String.to_existing_atom(perm) | acc]}}
      else
        {:halt, {:error, :invalid_permission_value}}
      end
    end)
  end

  defp verify_signature(claims, raw_decoded) do
    payload_map = raw_decoded
      |> Jason.decode!()
      |> Map.delete("sig")
      |> Jason.encode!()

    expected_sig = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @token_secret, payload_map)
      |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)

    if Plug.Crypto.secure_compare(expected_sig, claims.sig) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp verify_expiration(%{exp: exp, iat: iat}) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    cond do
      exp <= now -> {:error, :token_expired}
      exp - iat > @token_max_age -> {:error, :token_too_long_lived}
      iat > now + 30 -> {:error, :token_from_future}
      true -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp verify_permissions(%{perms: perms}) do
    if AuthGateway.PermissionEngine.valid_permission_set?(perms) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_permissions}
    end
  end
end

defmodule AuthGateway.AccessController do
  @moduledoc """
  Plug-based access controller for Phoenix endpoints.
  """
  import Plug.Conn
  alias AuthGateway.{TokenValidator, PermissionEngine}

  def init(opts), do: opts

  def call(conn, required_perms: required_perms) do
    with {:ok, token_string} <- extract_bearer_token(conn),
         {:ok, claims} <- TokenValidator.validate_token(token_string) do
      if PermissionEngine.has_permission?(claims.perms, required_perms) do
        conn
        |> assign(:current_user, claims.sub)
        |> assign(:user_permissions, claims.perms)
        |> assign(:permission_level, PermissionEngine.permission_level(claims.perms))
      else
        conn |> send_resp(403, "Insufficient permissions") |> halt()
      end
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        conn |> send_resp(401, "Authentication failed: #{reason}") |> halt()
    end
  end

  defp extract_bearer_token(conn) do
    case get_req_header(conn, "authorization") do
      ["Bearer " <> token] -> {:ok, token}
      _ -> {:error, :missing_token}
    end
  end
end
